metadata.title: BSI C5:2026 to Grundschutz++
metadata.remarks:
Generated by grundschutz-worksheets mapping.mjs from a mapping file. Do not edit by hand.

Targets of the BSI mapping not in the catalog, left out (19): BER.5.1.2 (iso27001 8.2); BER.6.8 (iso27001 5.17); BER.6.8 (iso27001 8.5); DET.3.1.13 (iso27001 5.23); GC.6.1.3 (iso27001 5.1); GC.6.1.4 (iso27001 5.1); GC.7.1.3 (iso27001 5.31); GC.8.1.1 (iso27001 5.2); GC.8.1.1.1 (iso27001 5.8); GC.8.1.3 (iso27001 5.3); GC.8.1.4 (iso27001 5.2); GC.9.1.2 (iso27001 5.8); GC.9.1.3 (iso27001 5.37); GC.10.2 (iso27001 5.37); GEB.5.4 (iso27001 7.8); PERF.1.1.1 (iso27001 5.7); PERF.5.1.4 (iso27001 5.35); PERF.6.1.3 (iso27001 5.7); PERF.7.1 (iso27001 5.1).

provenance.mapping-description: The 168 criteria of the Cloud Computing Compliance Criteria Catalogue C5:2026 (machine-readable release 1.0.1, BSI), one source per criterion (basic and additional criteria together). The six general conditions (GC) for the report are not requirements on the service and are left out. C5:2026 carries no references to ISO/IEC 27001, so each criterion names the Annex A controls it corresponds to; the Grundschutz++ targets of those controls come from the BSI's own mapping. Direct targets cover what Annex A lacks, notably ISMS clauses 4 to 10. The step from each criterion to ISO and the direct targets are a draft written with AI assistance and not yet reviewed by a person. C5 is published under CC BY-ND 4.0: only criterion IDs are reused here, every remark is our own wording.

Not mapped:

- INQ-01: Legal vetting of government data access requests before disclosure has no counterpart in Annex A or Grundschutz++.
- INQ-02: Notifying customers about government investigation requests is not addressed in Annex A or Grundschutz++.
- INQ-03: Limiting or pseudonymising data disclosed to authorities in investigations is not addressed by Annex A or Grundschutz++.
- INQ-04: Publishing technical procedures for disclosure to authorities to customers has no Annex A or Grundschutz++ counterpart.
